title: perf(console): a full-page record open asks its page list and object scope beside the permission read, and the app bar package list after the page
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDMrS4fMvsHHGRphzXxMdGZ)_

Fixes #35416

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUVVocvc9dVySV9DVf

## 维护者速读

- 用链接或刷新整页打开记录页时，记录页需要的页面清单和对象定义不再等权限接口返回之后才发，而是和权限接口同一批发出；托管环境上权限接口服务端要 3 秒多，这一段等待不再叠加在后面。
- 管理员打开任何应用页时，3MB 的包清单（`/api/v1/packages`）不再和记录数据抢同一条连接：页面自己的请求安静 0.75 秒后才去取（最多等 8 秒）。代价是应用栏的「在 Studio 中编辑」铅笔/眼睛图标晚出现约 1 秒（取到之前本来就不显示）。
- 出错时最坏情况是记录页打开速度回到改动前，或铅笔图标晚出现；不改任何接口和返回格式，可直接撤回。
- 卡上第 3 项「先出页面外壳」另立 #35981（等本 PR 合并）；包清单瘦身或 ETag 要改接口，本 PR 已把它移出启动链，暂不立卡。

## What changes

- `@object-ui/app-shell` `useAppObjectScopePrefetch` (`console/appObjectScope.ts`), the console root's prefetch that mounts beside `/auth/me/permissions`: on a record route it now asks the page list (`ensureType('page')`) and hands `readAppObjectScope` the same page-list and bundle readers `AppContent` hands it. So the record route's `/meta/page` read and, under `AppContent`'s own rule (objectstack#35455: not when the bundle answers a miss), the package object list (`/meta/object?package=`) leave as soon as the app list names the app. Before, the root passed no page-list reader, so on a record route both waited for `AppContent`, which mounts only after the permission read answers. `AppContent` reads the same entries and asks nothing twice. The page reader reads the provider's `pages` only when the record route asks (that getter starts the page list), so a list route asks no page list.
- `fetchSessionPackages` (`views/studio-design/packages-io.ts`), the session-held read behind the app bar's and the sidebar's Studio entries (`useStudioEntryGate`, and #35975's menus when it lands): a read it starts now waits for `whenQuiet(750, 8000)`, the page's counted requests (the data layer's settle signal) at zero for 750 ms, at most 8 s. A read already on the wire is joined at once, and a held list answers with no wait. Studio's own reads (`fetchPackages`, `fetchListedPackageIds`) are unchanged. The entries were already absent while the list was unread, and #35975 already fails open while unread, so nothing is drawn wrongly during the wait.
- `observability/settleSignal.ts`: new `whenQuiet(quietMs, maxMs)`. It resolves at once where no request was ever counted (no data layer wraps its `fetch` there, as in a host or a unit test without one). Not exported from the package entry.
- `/me/apps` is not changed: it starts after the permission read, but nothing on a named app's record route waits for it (`AppContent` reads it only to pick a default app), as the waterfalls below show.

Read first (risk order):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/appObjectScope.ts`, `useAppObjectScopePrefetch`: the `recordRoute` effect and the readers passed to `readAppObjectScope`.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/packages-io.ts`, `fetchSessionPackages`: the wait and the hold re-check after it.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/observability/settleSignal.ts`, `whenQuiet`.

## Why

The card measured 5 serial segments on an older hosted build. On `main` the full-page record open is 4 waves: `get-session` → `/auth/me/permissions` (+ `/meta/app`, bundle) → `/meta/page` + `/meta/object?package` + `/me/apps` → `POST /data/{object}/{id}/page`. The third wave existed only because the root prefetch could not read a record route's page list. And `/api/v1/packages` (1.3 MB unpacked on the showcase, 3.2 MB on the hosted CRM) started about 80 ms before the record's own read, on the same HTTP/2 connection; the card measured it downloading for 6.3 s while the record's 3 KB answer arrived 4.5 s after the server finished it.

## Verification

### Before/after, the same record page (local, see the gap below)

`examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev`, seeded admin), behind a local HTTP/2 TLS proxy so the browser multiplexes like the hosted edge (a plain local dev server is HTTP/1.1 and its 6-connection cap adds a fake wave). Chromium 1280×800, zh-CN, JS cached, DevTools network throttling, 3 runs per row, full-page open of `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_project/record/<id>`. Times in seconds from navigation start.

| Profile | | page data POST sent | `/meta/page` sent | `/api/v1/packages` sent |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 600 ms RTT, 3 Mbps | before | 2.06 / 2.07 / 2.09 | 1.31 / 1.32 / 1.35 (after permissions) | 1.98 / 2.00 / 2.02 (before page data) |
| | after | 1.75 / 1.79 / 1.85 | 0.70 / 0.73 / 0.78 (beside permissions) | 3.45 / 3.45 / 3.47 (after the page) |
| 300 ms RTT, 6 Mbps | before | 1.17 / 1.29 / 1.46 | 0.71 / 0.82 / 0.97 | 1.08 / 1.19 / 1.38 |
| | after | 1.11 / 1.22 / 1.42 | 0.39 / 0.49 / 0.69 | 2.35 / 2.39 / 2.70 |
| 300 ms RTT, 1.5 Mbps | before | 1.21 / 1.29 / 1.36 | 0.75 / 0.85 / 0.87 | 1.13 / 1.22 / 1.26 |
| | after | 0.92 / 1.12 / 1.37 | 0.41 / 0.49 / 0.62 | 2.44 / 2.52 / 2.63 |

- `/meta/page` and the package object list now leave in the permission read's wave in every run, and `/api/v1/packages` leaves after the page's requests in every run, so it is no longer among the record page's boot requests (the card's acceptance).
- The page data request leaves 0.2–0.3 s earlier at 600 ms RTT. It does not move a whole round trip locally: after the permission read answers, `AppContent` and the record page still render before the record's read can leave (0.4 s of client time in this container), and that render is what #35981 is for. On the hosted environment the saved wave was 1.4 s (card segment 4).
- ⚠ Gap: the hosted environment cannot be reached from this container, so these are local numbers, and DevTools throttling shapes each request alone: it does not reproduce two responses sharing one link's bandwidth, so the `/api/v1/packages` contention the card measured shows here only as the read moving after the page. A hosted before/after on the same record is owed once this is deployed.

Raw waterfalls (every request, start → end, bytes), the measurement script and the proxy: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35416/` in the project files (`h2-{before,after}-{300,600,slow}.txt`, `summary.txt`).

### Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/appObjectScope.rootRecordRoute-35416.test.tsx` (new, 3 cases, real `MetadataProvider`, only the root prefetch mounted, every read held per wave): a record route asks the app list, then the page list and the package list together; CONTROL a bundle that is a miss starts the page list alone; CONTROL a list route asks no page list.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/sessionPackagesAfterPageQuiet-35416.test.ts` (new, 7 cases, fake timers, fresh modules per case): waits while a page request is in flight and then for the quiet window; a request inside the window restarts it; the 8 s cap; readers in one commit share one read; CONTROLs: nothing counted reads at once, a read on the wire is joined at once, a held list answers with no read.
- Existing suites run locally and passing: `console/__tests__/appObjectScope-12811.test.tsx` (23), `hooks/__tests__/navGateUnionScope-12980.test.tsx`, `observability/settleSignal.test.ts`, `hooks/useStudioDesignGate.sessionHold-29119.test.tsx`. The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` package is left to CI's Test UI shards.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exit 0 (includes `tsconfig.test.json`). ESLint on the five files: 0 errors.

<details><summary>Ablations: each change reverted, its pin goes red</summary>

1. `appObjectScope.ts` restored to `main`: the record-route case and the miss CONTROL fail (the root asks no page list); the list-route CONTROL passes. Restored, 3 pass.
2. The `await whenQuiet(…)` line in `fetchSessionPackages` replaced by a no-op: the three waiting cases fail (the list is read at once); the four CONTROLs pass. Restored, 7 pass.

</details>

L1-b S2 (head `1e33395d`): `__resetSettleSignal` now also clears the new `counted` flag, so a test that resets the signal gets `whenQuiet`'s nothing-counted arm again. `settleSignal.test.ts`, the new 35416 test and `RecordDetailView.namedRecordPage-12715.test.tsx` (the reset's other caller) pass, 23/23.

## Follow-ups

- #35981: draw the app shell before the readiness gate (card item 3), Blocked-by this PR.
- The hosted before/after on the same record (card #35416's acceptance, "同一环境") is owed after deploy and is carried as an added acceptance line on #35981 (comment 7057574117), per the seat's ruling on L1-b's S1.
- No card for a trimmed `/api/v1/packages` or an ETag: both change the response (a contract face), and this PR already takes the read off the boot path. Worth one if the hosted re-measure still shows it hurting an admin's first page.

- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
